newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says China may buy rice to fulfill contract.
newsitem.headline: Manila says China may buy rice to fulfill contract.

text.p: China may buy rice from Vietnam and Thailand to meet a Philippine contract to supply up to 200,000 tonnes of rice, a senior Philippine Agriculture Department official told Reuters on Thursday.
The official was responding to doubts expressed by grains traders in the region that China may not be able to supply the required quantities of wheat to the Philippines.

"Based on the contract signed by the National Food Authority, China can source the rice from Vietnam and Thailand for as long as these are of the same quality (as specified)," the Philippine Agriculture Department official who requested not to be named said.
The Philippines is importing rice from China as part of its programme to boost buffer stocks by 650,000 tonnes before July this year.
Philippine rice output in the third quarter is traditionally low.
